name: Pilgrimage to Mecca
approach: Backpack in via Andrews Creek or Chewuch River trailheads to Upper Cathedral Lake (see West Route approach). From camp, walk about 15 minutes around the north side of Upper Cathedral Lake and scramble up to the base of the Ka'aba Buttress.

waypoints.name: Andrews Creek Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Highway 20 in Winthrop, turn onto County Road 1213 (West Chewuch Road) and follow it about 6 miles to where it joins Forest Road 51. Continue north on FR 51 to the end of the pavement and turn right into the Andrews Creek Trailhead at 3,050 ft. A Northwest Forest Pass or Interagency pass is needed to park, and a free self-issued Pasayten Wilderness permit is required.

waypoints.name: Ka'aba Buttress / Amphitheatre Mountain routes area
waypoints.directions: Hike Andrews Creek Trail #504 about 12 miles to Andrews Pass, keeping left near 5.5 miles and turning right at the Peepsight Trail junction. Descend 3 miles to the Spanish Camp guard station; just before the cabin take the trail on the right 3 miles up to Upper Cathedral Lake. Walk around the lake to Kaʼaba, the stepped buttress two left of Middle Finger (the biggest), and scramble to the large block at its base.

waypoints.name: Ka'aba Buttress / Pilgrimage to Mecca base area

road.name: West Chewuch Road (County Rd 1213) to Forest Road 51
road.driveNote: From Winthrop: Hwy 20 to County Rd 1213, 6 miles to FR 51, 22 miles of gravel to Andrews Creek Trailhead.
